children: Gap recruits Kirsten Green, founder and managing partner of venture capital firm Forerunner, to its board of directors. Green's firm has backed consumer-focused startups including Warby Parker, Dollar Shave Club, and Chime. The appointment brings venture capital expertise to a specialty apparel company seeking to deepen brand relevance. CEO Richard Dickson said Green has a track record of anticipating shifts in consumer behavior and translating those insights into business opportunities. Green's addition comes as Gap expands into beauty and accessories beyond its core apparel lines.
